name: table-3d-responsive-ui-upgrade
title: Upgrade table 3D modal on desktop and mobile
description: Refine the existing manager table 3D simulator into a clearer desktop workspace and a reliable single-column mobile workflow without changing business behavior.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Follow-up screenshot review found three presentation defects: raw license strings can enter compact model badges and overflow card bounds; the loading panel uses percentage insets that cover too much of the viewer; and the final repair stylesheet is imported before later table workflow/mobile styles. Reopened to fix those shared presentation boundaries without changing backend, GraphQL, AR persistence or callbacks.
